title: Composition of two machine runs
statement: Let $M_1$ and $M_2$ be deterministic machines with $k$ work tapes and a common input alphabet, with state sets $S_1$ and $S_2$. Form a machine on $S_1\sqcup S_2$ that follows $M_1$ on left states, switches from the specified exit state to the specified entry state in one step without changing the tapes, and follows $M_2$ on right states. If $M_1$ reaches configuration $c_1$ from $c_0$ after $T_1$ steps, first visiting the exit state at time $T_1$, and $M_2$ reaches $c_3$ after $T_2$ steps from $c_1$ with its state replaced by the entry state, then the composed machine, started from $c_0$ with its state placed in the left component, reaches $c_3$ with its state placed in the right component after $T_1+1+T_2$ steps.
